  <TITLE>Tara-oceans samples barcoding and shotgun sequencing</TITLE>
  <DESCRIPTION>This project relies on samples collected during the Tara Oceans and Tara Oceans Polar Circle scientific expeditions (2009-2012). The Tara schooner, equipped with innovative systems for sampling planktonic communities — from viruses to animals — collected standardized genetic (total DNA/RNA), morphological, and physico-chemical (contextual) samples from sites across the world’s oceans. These locations were carefully selected based on near-real-time remote sensing and in situ hydrographic criteria. The metagenomics component of the project includes size-fractionated plankton samples subjected to barcoding and shotgun sequencing, as well as isolated single-cell amplified protists and single metazoan organisms sequenced as reference genomes.</DESCRIPTION>

                <FIELD>

                    <NAME>sample_storage_location</NAME>

                    <NAME>project_name</NAME>

                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>

                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
            </FIELD_GROUP>
            <FIELD_GROUP restrictionType="Any number or none of the fields">
                <NAME>non-sample terms</NAME>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>ploidy</LABEL>
                    <NAME>ploidy</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>The ploidy level of the genome (e.g. allopolyploid, haploid, diploid, triploid, tetraploid). It has implications for the downstream study of duplicated gene and regions of the genomes (and perhaps for difficulties in assembly). For terms, please select terms listed under class ploidy (PATO:001374) of Phenotypic Quality Ontology (PATO), and for a browser of PATO (v 2018-03-27) please refer to http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/PATO</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>number of replicons</LABEL>
                    <NAME>number_of_replicons</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Reports the number of replicons in a nuclear genome of eukaryotes, in the genome of a bacterium or archaea or the number of segments in a segmented virus. Always applied to the haploid chromosome count of a eukaryote. Mandatory for MIGS of eukaryotes, bacteria, archaea and segmented virus.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD>
                            <REGEX_VALUE>[+-]?[0-9]+</REGEX_VALUE>
                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>

                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>extrachromosomal elements</LABEL>
                    <NAME>extrachromosomal_elements</NAME>

                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>estimated size</LABEL>
                    <NAME>estimated_size</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>The estimated size of the genome (in bp) prior to sequencing. Of particular importance in the sequencing of (eukaryotic) genome which could remain in draft form for a long or unspecified period. Mandatory for MIGS of eukaryotes.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD>
                            <REGEX_VALUE>[+-]?[0-9]+</REGEX_VALUE>
                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>

                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>

                    <LABEL>target gene</LABEL>
                    <NAME>target_gene</NAME>

                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>target subfragment</LABEL>
                    <NAME>target_subfragment</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Name of subfragment of a gene or locus. Important to e.g. identify special regions on marker genes like V6 on 16S rRNA</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>multiplex identifiers</LABEL>
                    <NAME>multiplex_identifiers</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Molecular barcodes, called Multiplex Identifiers (MIDs), that are used to specifically tag unique samples in a sequencing run. Sequence should be reported in uppercase letters</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>sequence quality check</LABEL>
                    <NAME>sequence_quality_check</NAME>

                            </TEXT_VALUE>
                            <TEXT_VALUE>

                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>chimera check software</LABEL>
                    <NAME>chimera_check_software</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Tool(s) used for chimera checking, including version number and parameters, to discover and remove chimeric sequences. A chimeric sequence is comprised of two or more phylogenetically distinct parent sequences.</DESCRIPTION>

                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
            </FIELD_GROUP>
            <FIELD_GROUP restrictionType="Any number or none of the fields">
                <NAME>Reference</NAME>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>isolation and growth condition</LABEL>
                    <NAME>isolation_and_growth_condition</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Publication reference in the form of pubmed ID (pmid), digital object identifier (doi) or url for isolation and growth condition specifications of the organism/material. Mandatory for MIGS and MIMARKS Specimen.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>annotation source</LABEL>
                    <NAME>annotation_source</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>For cases where annotation was provided by a community jamboree or model organism database rather than by a specific submitter</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>reference for biomaterial</LABEL>
                    <NAME>reference_for_biomaterial</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Primary publication if isolated before genome publication; otherwise, primary genome report. Mandatory for MIGS of bacteria and archaea.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
            </FIELD_GROUP>
            <FIELD_GROUP restrictionType="Any number or none of the fields">
                <NAME>sample processing</NAME>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>sample material processing</LABEL>
                    <NAME>sample_material_processing</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>A brief description of any processing applied to the sample during or after retrieving the sample from environment, or a link to the relevant protocol(s) performed.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>sample volume or weight for DNA extraction</LABEL>
                    <NAME>sample_volume_or_weight_for_dna_extraction</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Volume (ml) or mass (g) of total collected sample processed for DNA extraction. Note: total sample collected should be entered under the term 'sample size'.</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD>
                            <REGEX_VALUE>(0|((0\.)|([1-9][0-9]*\.?))[0-9]*)([Ee][+-]?[0-9]+)?</REGEX_VALUE>
                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <UNITS>
                        <UNIT>g</UNIT>
                        <UNIT>ng</UNIT>
                        <UNIT>mg</UNIT>
                        <UNIT>mL</UNIT>
                    </UNITS>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>nucleic acid extraction</LABEL>
                    <NAME>nucleic_acid_extraction</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the material separation to recover the nucleic acid fraction from a sample</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>nucleic acid amplification</LABEL>
                    <NAME>nucleic_acid_amplification</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the enzymatic amplification (PCR, TMA, NASBA) of specific nucleic acids</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>library size</LABEL>
                    <NAME>library_size</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Total number of clones in the library prepared for the project</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD>
                            <REGEX_VALUE>[+-]?[0-9]+</REGEX_VALUE>
                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>library reads sequenced</LABEL>
                    <NAME>library_reads_sequenced</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Total number of clones sequenced from the library</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD>
                            <REGEX_VALUE>[+-]?[0-9]+</REGEX_VALUE>
                        </TEXT_FIELD>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>library construction method</LABEL>
                    <NAME>library_construction_method</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Library construction method used for clone libraries</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>library vector</LABEL>
                    <NAME>library_vector</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Cloning vector type(s) used in construction of libraries</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>library screening strategy</LABEL>
                    <NAME>library_screening_strategy</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Specific enrichment or screening methods applied before and/or after creating clone libraries in order to select a specific group of sequences</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>pcr conditions</LABEL>
                    <NAME>pcr_conditions</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Description of reaction conditions and components for PCR in the form of 'initial denaturation:94degC_1.5min; annealing=...'</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>pcr primers</LABEL>
                    <NAME>pcr_primers</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>PCR primers that were used to amplify the sequence of the targeted gene, locus or subfragment. This field should contain all the primers used for a single PCR reaction if multiple forward or reverse primers are present in a single PCR reaction. The primer sequence should be reported in uppercase letters</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>adapters</LABEL>
                    <NAME>adapters</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>Adapters provide priming sequences for both amplification and sequencing of the sample-library fragments. Both adapters should be reported; in uppercase letters</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
            </FIELD_GROUP>
            <FIELD_GROUP restrictionType="Any number or none of the fields">
                <NAME>local environment conditions imposed</NAME>
                <FIELD>
                    <LABEL>chemical administration</LABEL>
                    <NAME>chemical_administration</NAME>
                    <DESCRIPTION>list of chemical compounds administered to the host or site where sampling occurred, and when (e.g. antibiotics, N fertilizer, air filter); can include multiple compounds. For Chemical Entities of Biological Interest ontology (CHEBI) (v111), please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/CHEBI</DESCRIPTION>
                    <FIELD_TYPE>
                        <TEXT_FIELD/>
                    </FIELD_TYPE>
                    <MANDATORY>optional</MANDATORY>
                    <MULTIPLICITY>single</MULTIPLICITY>
                </FIELD>
            </FIELD_GROUP>
        </DESCRIPTOR>
    </CHECKLIST>
</CHECKLIST_SET>
